newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast cocoa bean exports up in February.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast cocoa bean exports up in February.

text.p: Ivory Coast cocoa bean exports rose to 148,827 tonnes in February against 137,664 tonnes in January and 118,023 tonnes in February 1996, official shipping data show.
Cumulative exports for the first five months of the 1996/97 (Oct-Sept) season were 596,233 tonnes against 553,238 tonnes in the same period of the record 1995/96 season.
Ivory Coast produced 1.2 million tonnes of cocoa in 1995/96 and is set for another large harvest in 1996/97.
Port arrivals of cocoa stood at 970-980,000 tonnes by mid-April 1997 as the main crop (Oct-April) tailed off, compared to 1.03 million tonnes in 1995/96.
Figures show that Abidjan handled 109,190 tonnes of February 1997 exports with 39,637 tonnes leaving via the second Ivorian port, San Pedro.
Over half of bean exports, or 79,975 tonnes, were shipped to Dutch ports, the data show.
